skill.displayName: CTR Fix: Title and Meta Description Rewrites - SEOmatic

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent SEO workflow that uses SEOmatic and Search Console data to propose or stage CTR improvements, with approval required before changes go live.

dimensions.detail: No local scripts, package installs, filesystem access, or broad host access are present; the environment use is limited to the external SEOmatic MCP tools.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill connects to the SEOmatic MCP server using OAuth or a Bearer API key; this is disclosed and consistent with the integration purpose.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to page-1 CTR improvement, require real GSC data, limit staged work to up to 5 tasks, and explicitly forbid approving changes without user confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Staged tasks and approved changes may persist in SEOmatic or the connected site, but the artifact discloses approval gates, rollback, and user-directed task approval.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The requested capabilities match the stated purpose: reading Search Console performance, SERP features, and current page snippets to propose title and meta description changes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that SEOmatic will access real Search Console and site page data, and paid-plan staging can prepare changes for approval. Only approve specific staged tasks you have reviewed, especially if the connected site is business-critical.
